title: Anticonceptie en gezinsvorming 1974

descriptions: Information on previous pregnancies / talking with husband about family planning and anti-conception / types of anti-conception used / experiences with general practitioner about anti-conception / use of the pill / reasons for not using the pill / opinions on sterilization / opinions on efficacy of types of anti-conception / knowledge of fertile period of women.
